contentBody.headMarkup:
<meta name="google" content="notranslate">
<!-- General -->
<link rel="shortcut icon" href="{ basePath }/sfsites/c/resource/PMC_DH_FavIcon?{ versionKey }">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{basePath}/assets/css/theme.css?{versionKey}">

<!-- webruntime-branding-shared stylesheets -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/salesforce-lightning-design-system.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-site-spacing-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-slds-extensions.min.css?{ versionKey }" />

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/themes/alpine.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/sfsites/c/resource/pmc_brandingStaticResource/styles/style.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<!-- webruntime-branding-shared stylesheets -->

<style>
    .md-list-container {
        .md-datatable-container {
            th,
            td,
            span {
                font-family: var(--medium-font);
                line-height: 19px;
                color: var(--md-primary-dark-green);
                /*font-size: var(--regular-font-size);*/
                font-weight: 500;
                white-space: pre;
                padding-top: 0;
                padding-bottom: 0;
            }

            .slds-table thead th {
                color: var(--md-brand-primary-gray);
                font-weight: 700;
            }

            .slds-cell-fixed {
                background-color: unset;
            }

            .slds-table_header-fixed_container {
                background-color: unset;
                padding-top: 2.6rem;
            }

            th a,
            th .slds-has-button-menu {
                background-color: var(--md-light-green);
            }

            th:first-child a {
                border-top-left-radius: 8px;
                background-color: var(--md-light-green);
            }

            th:last-child {
                a {
                    border-top-right-radius: 8px;
                    background-color: var(--md-light-green);
                }

                .slds-resizable__divider:after,
                .slds-resizable__handle {
                    display: none;
                }
            }

            th {
                .slds-th__action {
                    height: unset;
                    padding: 1rem;            
                    user-select: none;        
                }

                .slds-th__action:hover, .slds-has-focus.slds-is-resizable .slds-th__action {
                    background-color: var(--md-light-green);
                }
            }

            tbody td {
                min-height: 45px;
                max-width: 200px;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
                word-break: break-word;
                hyphens: auto;
            }

            .slds-table_header-fixed_container[lwc-392cvb27u8q]>.slds-scrollable_y[lwc-392cvb27u8q]::before,
            .slds-table_header-fixed_container > .slds-scrollable_y::before,
            .slds-table {
                border-bottom: 0;
            }

            .slds-scrollable--x,
            .slds-scrollable_x {
                /*overflow-x: hidden;*/
                padding-top: 2.6rem;
            }

            .slds-line-clamp {
                white-space: normal;
                word-wrap: break-word;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
                word-break: keep-all;
                hyphens: none;
                line-height: 1.3;
            }
        }
    }

    /* FIX PLACE ORDER SHIPTO ICON */
    .shipto-wrapper .shipToLocation .slds-button_icon {
        margin-top: -.91em;
      	right: 0;
    }

    @media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
        .md-list-container {
            .md-table-container {
                .slds-scrollable_x {
                    max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /* framework.css */
    :root {
        --md-primary-dark-green: #093532;
        --md-secondary-dark-green: #436462;
        --md-tertiary-dark-green: #a0b1b0;
        --md-green-actions: #005909;
        --md-brand-primary-green: #1d625c;
        --md-secondary-green: #BFD0CE;
        --md-tertiary-green: #D4DFDE;
        --md-light-green: #E9EFEE;
        --md-brand-primary-gray: #646E6E;
        --md-secondary-gray: #D6D6D6;
        --md-tertiary-gray: #F0F0F0;
        --md-brand-primary-orange: #cc7429;
        --md-secondary-orange: #EFE1D6;
        --md-tertiary-orange: #FFFDFB;
        --md-error: #A61A14;
    }

    .md-container {
        margin: 0 1rem;
    }

    .md-list-container {
        margin: 0 1rem;
    }

    .md-grid {
        display: grid;
        column-gap: 1rem;
    }

    .md-p-1 {
        padding: 1rem;
    }

    .md-my-2 {
        margin-top: 1rem;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .md-mb-0 {
        margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .md-mb-2 {
        margin-bottom: 1em !important;
    }

    .md-mb-4 {
        margin-bottom: 2em !important;
    }

    .md-mt-1 {
        margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    .md-mt-2 {
        margin-top: 2rem;
    }

    .md-p-title {
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    .md-span {
        font-size: 16px;
    }

    .md-align-flex-end {
        align-items: flex-end;
    }

    .md-align-center {
        align-items: center;
    }

    .md-big-title {
        font-family: var(--bold-font);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: var(--xx-large-font-size);
        line-height: 26px;
        color: var(--md-primary-dark-green);
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .md-box {
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1);
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .md-box .md-header {
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--md-secondary-green);
        border-top-left-radius: 8px;
        border-top-right-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--md-tertiary-gray);
        padding: 13px 16px;
        color: var(--md-primary-dark-green);
        font-family: var(--medium-font);
        line-height: 22px;
        font-weight: bold;
    }

    .md-box .md-body {
        padding: 1rem;
    }

    .md-button {
        border: none;
        transition: ease .2s;
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: .7076rem 1rem;
        font-family: var(--regular-font);
        font-size: var(--small-font-size);
        font-weight: bold;
    }

    .md-default-button {
        background-color: var(--md-primary-dark-green);
        color: white;

        &:hover {
            background-color: var(--md-secondary-dark-green);
            transition: ease .2s;
        }
    }

    .md-light-button {
        /*margin-left: auto;*/
        background-color: var(--md-light-green);
        color: var(--md-primary-dark-green);

        &:hover {
            background-color: var(--md-tertiary-green);
            transition: ease .2s;
        }
    }

    .md-input-box {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: auto auto;
        column-gap: 1rem;
        align-items: flex-end;
    }

    .md-input-box p {
        font-size: 14px;
        font-family: var(--regular-font);
        font-weight: 400;
        -webkit-text-decoration: var(--dxp-s-body-text-decoration);
        text-decoration: var(--dxp-s-body-text-decoration);
        text-transform: var(--dxp-s-body-text-transform);
        line-height: var(--dxp-s-body-line-height);
        letter-spacing: var(--dxp-s-body-letter-spacing);
        text-shadow: var(--dxp-s-body-text-shadow);
        color: var(--dxp-s-body-text-color, var(--dxp-g-root-contrast));
        line-height: 17px;
        margin-bottom: .5rem;
    }

    .md-input-box input {
        background: var(--white);
        border: 1.4px solid var(--md-secondary-green);
        border-radius: 4px;
        /* padding: .7rem; */
        padding: 1em;
        max-height: 40px;
        color: var(--md-brand-primary-gray);
        font-size: var(--x-small-font-size);
        font-family: var(--medium-font);
        transition: ease all .2s;

        &:hover, &:focus {
            transition: ease all .2s;
            border-color: var(--md-primary-dark-green);
            border-width: 1.4px;
            outline: 0;
        }

        &:focus {
            border-color: var(--md-primary-dark-green);
            box-shadow: 0 0 3px 0 var(--md-primary-dark-green);
        }
    }

    .md-input-box button {
        padding: .8em 1rem;
    }

    .md-date-input {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .md-date-input {
        .slds-input {
            /* padding: .575rem; */
            padding: .834em;
            max-height: 40px;
            color: var(--md-brand-primary-gray);
            font-size: var(--x-small-font-size);
            font-family: var(--medium-font);

            &:hover, &:focus {
                border-color: var(--md-primary-dark-green);
            }
        }

        .slds-form-element__help {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .slds-input-has-icon .slds-input__icon {
            margin-top: -.66rem;
        }
    }

    .md-grid-container .md-date-input {
        --slds-c-input-spacing-horizontal-end: .8rem;
        --slds-c-input-spacing-horizontal-start: .8rem;
        --dxp-s-form-element-spacing-block-start: .8rem;
        --dxp-s-form-element-spacing-block-end: .8rem;
    }

    .md-table-container {
        border: 1px solid var(--md-secondary-gray);
        box-shadow: 0px 0px 15px rgba(9, 53, 50, 0.1);
        border-radius: 0.5rem;
        background-color: var(--slds-g-color-neutral-base-100, #fff);
    }

    .md-pagination {
        display: grid;
        grid-auto-flow: column;
        column-gap: .5em;
    }

    .md-pagination-button {
        font-family: var(--regular-font);
        line-height: 17px;
        font-weight: 400;
        height: 40px;
        color: var(--md-brand-primary-green);
        user-select: none;
        letter-spacing: 0.11px;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        display: flex;
        white-space: nowrap;
        padding: .5em .5em .6rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--md-tertiary-green);
        box-shadow: 0px 10px 30px #f7fbfa;
        min-width: 40px;
        background-color: white;
    }

    .md-pagination-button[data-active="true"] {
        background-color: var(--md-light-green);
    }

    .md-info-message {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
        padding: .7rem;
        column-gap: .5rem;
        background: var(--md-light-green);
        align-items: center;
        margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    .md-info-message span {
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    .md-info-message lightning-icon {
        filter: sepia(1) brightness(.5) hue-rotate(140deg);
    }

    .md-inline-error {
        background: var(--md-error);
        color: #ffffff;
        padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
        border-radius: 6px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        max-width: 360px;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
    }

    .md-inline-error-text {
        color: #ffffff;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .md-multi-panel {
        .slds-input::placeholder {
            position: absolute;
            left: 32px;
            top: 12px;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        input[type="search"] {
            padding-left: 2.7em;
        }

        .slds-form-element {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
    }

    .md-hero-banner {
        box-shadow: 0 0 10px #00000017;
        
        * {
            border-radius: 6px;
        }
    }

    .md-admin-region-selector .slds-form-element {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .xls-btn-container .md-button {
        padding-top: .8em;
    	padding-bottom: 1em;
    }
    
    .md-table-container .slds-line-clamp, .md-intransit-datatable .slds-line-clamp {
        overflow: unset;
        -webkit-line-clamp: unset;
    }
</style>
